fail_safe.principle: The shield is a hardware-level interlock independent of the learned policy. It evaluates every control cycle and overrides the policy command when a guard band is crossed.
rules: IF T_water_top >= bypass_water_C: force BYPASS (isolate collector, pump OFF).
IF T_pcm >= bypass_pcm_C AND T_water > T_pcm: block the charge heat path.
IF pump commanded ON and the flow sensor reads ~0 (dry run): stop the pump, raise a fault.
IF any sensor stale > stale_timeout_s: fail to BYPASS (safe default), raise a fault.
IF the f_melt estimator diverges from the T_pcm-implied enthalpy: fall back to reactive rule B1 and raise an alarm.
IF a hard limit is exceeded despite the shield: latch fault, pump OFF, alarm, require manual reset.
fail_safe.control_cycle_note: The policy decides once per HOUR (plan 3.0). Sensors are sampled faster; the shield runs every 10 s.

provenance_note: Thermal state (T_pcm, f_melt, stored and recoverable energy) is estimated, not measured. Simulation results do not constitute experimental validation; that is Objective 4's purpose.
